description: A finite Horn theory has a model if and only if no constraint body is contained in its forward closure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.satisfies_iff.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) :
  (∃ X, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ X) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.constraintsPass Γ (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ) =
      true
